name: Haus Egger
beschreibung:
Peacefully located in the mountaineering hub of Matrei in Osttirol, Haus Egger offers cosy guestrooms and friendly personal attention. It is a wonderful haven for nature lovers.

The Grossglockner Resort Kals-Matrei ski lifts, national park trails, and village amenities are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Egger in Matrei in Osttirol provides restful holidays facing the Hohe Tauern National Park.
